name: CloudNativePG
description: Read-only CloudNativePG operator inspection through explicit installed CRD endpoints. No reconcile, rollout, restore, backup execution or secret object reads.

permissions.description: Provider operations may read/write/delete external resources, refresh OAuth tokens, send mail, access local files or mutate ONF state when deliberately executed. Required credential names are configured per node; inspect each pinned definition help and connection settings. Declarations are advisory, not a sandbox. Installation runs no code.

definitions.name: Kubernetes Resource
Kubernetes Resource List
CloudNativePG List Connection Poolers
definitions.description: Inspect connection poolers desired configuration and observed operator state. Requires the postgresql.cnpg.io/v1 CRD served by the target Kubernetes API; returns the shared Resource envelope, with explicit JSON spec/status.
definitions.documentation:
Inspect connection poolers desired configuration and observed operator state. Requires the postgresql.cnpg.io/v1 CRD served by the target Kubernetes API; returns the shared Resource envelope, with explicit JSON spec/status.

GET /apis/postgresql.cnpg.io/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/poolers. Read operation.

Inputs: namespace (optional), labelSelector (optional), limit (optional), continuation (optional). Missing inputs may come from the selected connection profile config or explicit node defaults. Outputs: status, request_id, operation_url, items, count, has_more, continuation. Optional outputs are absent when the provider omits them. HTTP202 is acceptance, not completed work; operation_url exposes a same-origin asynchronous status URL when supplied.

Setup: configure baseUrl (https://kubernetes.example.com), bearer credentials through encrypted secret names or Connections. Default secret name: KUBERNETES_TOKEN. Connection credentials accessToken/apiKey or username/password are resolved at execution. Never put credentials in literal inputs, baseUrl or logs. Required access: Kubernetes list RBAC for poolers.postgresql.cnpg.io in the selected namespace.

Bounds: requestTimeoutMs=15000 (100..120000), maxBytes=1048576 (1024..3000000), maxItems=1000 (1..5000), maxPages=1 (1..20). Follow bounded provider continuation or pass continuation to fetch the next page. has_more reports an unconsumed continuation. HTTPS is required; private HTTP needs allowHttp=true. TLS validation remains enabled. Redirects, cross-origin/escaped continuation URLs and repeated continuations fail. No implicit retries. Error text contains provider/status only, never raw response bodies or credentials. Reconcile an uncertain external action before another attempt.

Synthetic example inputs:

```json
{
  "namespace": "demo"
}
```

This example is documentation, not a run. 

Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/docs/current/cloudnative-pg.v1/ https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/main/config/crd/bases/postgresql.cnpg.io_clusters.yaml
